name: facebookresearch_grounded-video-description/misc/AGENT.python.tools.md

facebookresearch_grounded-video-descript.build_attention_module: build a PyTorch Attention module that computes additive attention weights over visual features using an RNN hidden state
facebookresearch_grounded-video-descript.build_attention2_module: build an Attention2 module with configurable region attention modes including additive, multiplicative, and dot-product variants
facebookresearch_grounded-video-descript.build_topdown_core: build a TopDownCore module that combines two LSTM cells with dual attention mechanisms for grounded video description
facebookresearch_grounded-video-descript.build_topdown_model: build a TopDownModel that wraps TopDownCore as a 2-layer attention-based language model for video captioning
facebookresearch_grounded-video-descript.review_attention_forward: review the Attention forward method to understand how softmax-weighted feature aggregation produces attention residuals

facebookresearch_grounded-video-descript.run_beam_search_caption: run beam search on CaptionModel to generate video captions from visual features and RNN state
facebookresearch_grounded-video-descript.review_CaptionModel_beam_search: review the CaptionModel beam_search method for attention-based caption generation with pointer network masking
facebookresearch_grounded-video-descript.refactor_beam_step_nested: refactor the nested beam_step function in beam_search to be a standalone method of CaptionModel
facebookresearch_grounded-video-descript.test_CaptionModel_initialization: test the CaptionModel class initialization and verify it inherits from nn.Module correctly
facebookresearch_grounded-video-descript.summarize_beam_search_decoding: summarize the beam search decoding logic that generates caption sequences using log-probability scoring

facebookresearch_grounded-video-descript.build_bbox_transform: build a python module to compute normalized bounding box transformation targets from expected and ground truth ROIs
facebookresearch_grounded-video-descript.build_bbox_transform_batch: build a python module to compute batched bounding box transformation targets for 2D or 3D ROI tensors
facebookresearch_grounded-video-descript.build_bbox_transform_inv: build a python module to invert bounding box deltas and predict refined box coordinates from anchor boxes
facebookresearch_grounded-video-descript.build_clip_boxes_batch: build a python module to clip batched bounding box coordinates to image boundary limits
facebookresearch_grounded-video-descript.build_bbox_overlaps_batch: build a python module to compute batched IoU overlap between anchor boxes and ground truth boxes

facebookresearch_grounded-video-descript.create_DataLoader_instance: create a DataLoader instance with opt config to load ActivityNet video segment data for training
facebookresearch_grounded-video-descript.review_DataLoader_init: review the DataLoader class __init__ method to understand how GloVe vectors and proposal files are loaded
facebookresearch_grounded-video-descript.summarize_get_det_word: summarize the get_det_word method that maps bounding box annotations to caption word indices
facebookresearch_grounded-video-descript.refactor_get_frm_mask: refactor the get_frm_mask method to improve frame mask computation between proposals and ground truth boxes
facebookresearch_grounded-video-descript.test_DataLoader_getitem: test the DataLoader __getitem__ method to verify it returns correct tensors for video segment data

facebookresearch_grounded-video-descript.build_AttModel: build a grounded video description model with attention-based captioning using the AttModel class
facebookresearch_grounded-video-descript.run_AttModel_forward: run the AttModel forward pass with MLE training on segmented video features and ground truth sequences
facebookresearch_grounded-video-descript.run_AttModel_sample: run the AttModel sampling method to generate video captions from proposal features and masks
facebookresearch_grounded-video-descript.run_AttModel_beam_search: run beam search inference on the AttModel to generate top-k caption sequences for video clips
facebookresearch_grounded-video-descript.review_AttModel_grounder: review the AttModel grounder method that computes attention scores between text embeddings and visual region features

facebookresearch_grounded-video-descript.build_transformer_encoder: build a Transformer encoder model with configurable d_model, n_layers, n_heads, and dropout ratio
facebookresearch_grounded-video-descript.build_transformer_decoder: build a TransformerDecoder model with greedy inference or cross-entropy training mode
facebookresearch_grounded-video-descript.create_attention_layer: create a MultiHead attention layer with configurable heads, causal masking, and dropout
facebookresearch_grounded-video-descript.create_positional_encodings: create sinusoidal positional encodings for a given tensor shape using positional_encodings_like
facebookresearch_grounded-video-descript.build_encoder_decoder_pipeline: build an encoder-decoder pipeline using Transformer and TransformerDecoder for sequence generation

facebookresearch_grounded-video-descript.decode_sequence: decode a PyTorch tensor of token IDs into human-readable text sequences using an index-to-word mapping
facebookresearch_grounded-video-descript.update_values: recursively update a target dictionary with non-None values from a source dictionary including nested dicts
